_doc: Which games open the site, and which buttons filter them. Everything else is still collected, still checked and still published — it moves to the second tab rather than disappearing, because a game dropped is a game that cannot be found again. A game qualifies on ONE side: a friendly is interesting when either club is, so Maccabi Tel Aviv against a German second-division side belongs here. build.mjs stamps `featured` and `groups` onto each club in teams.json; index.html only reads them.
_groups: Every entry below is one filter button on the front tab, and the front tab offers no others — a button for a competition that is not on this list would be filtering by something nobody asked to see.
_countries: Clubs carry a European competition or nothing at all — there is no per-league tag for domestic basketball anywhere in the data — so a domestic league is selected by the country of its clubs. It is a little wider than the top division: Ourense and Coto Cordoba are Spanish without being ACB. They earn their place anyway, because the games that brought them into the data are games against ACB clubs.
_clubs: Named one by one, matched on the Hebrew name, the source name or any alias. A name that matches nothing is reported by the build and fails a check rather than quietly narrowing the tab.
